post.summary:
POST /auth/magic-link/verify — atomic consume, then session login with id
regeneration (fixation defense). Uniform 422 on any failure

get.summary: GET /auth/mfa — safe MFA state for the SPA

post.summary: POST /auth/mfa/challenge — verify a TOTP code, asserting the session
POST /auth/mfa/confirm — confirm enrollment; returns recovery codes once
POST /auth/mfa/enroll — start TOTP enrollment; returns the secret + URI once
POST /auth/mfa/recovery-challenge — same contract, via a recovery code

POST /auth/mfa/recovery-codes — regenerate the recovery-code set
(step-up protected at the route). Returns the new codes once

errors.description: A detailed description of each field that failed validation.

AcceptStaffInvitationRequest.title: AcceptStaffInvitationRequest

AssignAppointmentRequest.description:
Assign-personnel validation (Plan §36). The target personnel is a public staff
ULID resolved inside the appointment's branch; eligibility + availability are
revalidated by the shared PersonnelSchedulingValidator in the action.
AssignAppointmentRequest.title: AssignAppointmentRequest

memberships.description: Retained for guard compatibility; mirrors the single active membership.

branch_ids.description:
Active branch assignments (Plan §8.2). Empty for a merchant_admin —
they see all own-merchant branches — and for non-merchant users.

permissions.description:
Resolved permission keys (Plan §10.3): role default grants ± per-user
overrides, request-cached by TenantContext. UX only — the backend
(EnsurePermission + policies) is the security boundary.

mfa.description:
Safe MFA state (Plan §18): drives the SPA enrollment/challenge/
step-up routing. Never exposes the secret or recovery-code hashes.

CancelAppointmentRequest.description:
Cancel-appointment validation (Plan §36, §25.2). A reason is optional before
check-in and REQUIRED after check-in (`cancelled_with_reason`) — the after-
check-in requirement is enforced in the action against the locked current state
(the request cannot see it), where a missing reason returns 422. The reason is
sanitised before it reaches the audit record.
CancelAppointmentRequest.title: CancelAppointmentRequest

ChangeConsentRequest.description:
SMS-consent change validation (Plan §35). Channel is implicitly `sms` (the only
channel in Phase 15A); only the state is supplied.
ChangeConsentRequest.title: ChangeConsentRequest

CompleteFirstTimeSetupRequest.description:
Validates first-time setup completion (Scope §3.2 steps 1–5).

Route access (pending_setup + merchant_admin) is enforced by middleware; this
validates the payload shape. Cross-field rules ensure the two initial staff
emails are distinct from each other and from the owner — the Merchant
Administrator may add ONLY a Branch Manager and an HR user (Scope §3.2
"Add only ... Branch account user ... and ... Human Resource account user").
CompleteFirstTimeSetupRequest.title: CompleteFirstTimeSetupRequest

CreateBranchRequest.description:
Validate branch creation (Scope §3.3). Code is unique per merchant (admin-only
authority is enforced in the controller).
CreateBranchRequest.title: CreateBranchRequest

CreateStaffInvitationRequest.description:
Validate a staff invitation (Scope §3.4). Branch is referenced by ULID; a
duplicate PENDING invite for the same merchant+email+role+branch is blocked
(the DB partial unique index is the backstop).
CreateStaffInvitationRequest.title: CreateStaffInvitationRequest

EmergencyUnavailableRequest.description:
HR-only emergency-unavailability payload (Plan §80 Phase 15B). Creates a
date-specific UNAVAILABLE exception interval; HR authority is route-gated
(`personnel.availability.manage`) + policy-checked. A non-empty change reason is
mandatory. merchant_id / branch_id are never accepted from the body.
EmergencyUnavailableRequest.title: EmergencyUnavailableRequest

MfaCodeRequest.description:
Validates a submitted MFA code — a 6-digit TOTP or a recovery code (Plan §18).

Only shape is validated; whether the code is genuine is decided by the TOTP
verification / atomic recovery-code consume, never by validation, so timing
and messages stay uniform. Authorization is the route's `auth:sanctum` +
EnsurePrivilegedMfa; this request is shared by confirm/challenge/recovery.
MfaCodeRequest.title: MfaCodeRequest

RegisterMerchantRequest.description:
Validates Merchant Administrator self-registration (Scope §3.2).

Public endpoint (no auth). Deliberately minimal + safe: owner name, email,
business name. No KYC / compliance fields exist (Scope §3.1 exclusion). Email
uniqueness is NOT asserted here — duplicate emails are handled uniformly in
the action so this endpoint cannot enumerate existing accounts.
RegisterMerchantRequest.title: RegisterMerchantRequest

RequestMagicLinkRequest.description: Validates a Magic Link request (Plan §9.1). Public endpoint — no auth.
RequestMagicLinkRequest.title: RequestMagicLinkRequest

RescheduleAppointmentRequest.description:
Reschedule-appointment validation (Plan §36). Accepts a new start only; the new
end is recomputed from the service-duration snapshot in the action, and the
branch calendar + personnel availability are revalidated for the new interval.
RescheduleAppointmentRequest.title: RescheduleAppointmentRequest

status.description: Membership status drives the UI badge: invited|active|suspended|deactivated.

StoreAppointmentRequest.description:
Create-appointment validation (Plan §36). Accepts only safe public identifiers:
a branch-scoped client + active service (ULIDs), a scheduled start, and optional
preferred/assigned personnel (ULIDs). The backend derives the merchant, branch,
end-time (service-duration snapshot), initial status, actor, and timestamps —
`merchant_id`, `branch_id` (as ownership), `status`, `ends_at`, `created_by`, and
internal database ids are NEVER accepted from the body. `branch_id` is an
optional branch ULID used only to disambiguate the write branch.
StoreAppointmentRequest.title: StoreAppointmentRequest

StoreClientRequest.description:
Create-client validation (Plan §35). Phone is required and normalized/encrypted/
indexed in the action; email is optional and encrypted. `branch_id` is an
optional branch ULID resolved in the controller.
StoreClientRequest.title: StoreClientRequest

StoreEligibilityRequest.description:
Assign-eligibility validation (Plan §39). The service comes from the route
binding (`/services/{service}/eligibility`); the body carries the personnel
staff ULID. Same-branch/same-tenant linkage is enforced in AssignEligibility +
the composite FKs.
StoreEligibilityRequest.title: StoreEligibilityRequest

StoreFileRequest.description:
Validated multipart upload request (Plan §65; Phase 10F). Only currently
uploadable purposes are accepted at the request layer; the pipeline performs the
authoritative server-side content validation (magic-byte MIME, dangerous-file
rejection). A coarse size ceiling here fails huge uploads fast; the per-purpose
byte limit is enforced in the pipeline.
StoreFileRequest.title: StoreFileRequest

StorePermissionOverrideRequest.description:
Validate a permission-override request (Plan §10.3). The capability key must
exist in the seeded catalogue; authority + grantability + anti-escalation are
enforced by PermissionOverrideService.
StorePermissionOverrideRequest.title: StorePermissionOverrideRequest

StoreServiceCategoryRequest.description:
Create-service-category validation (Plan §39). Branch-scoped active-name
uniqueness is a DB partial unique index; `branch_id` is an optional branch ULID
resolved in the controller.
StoreServiceCategoryRequest.title: StoreServiceCategoryRequest

StoreServiceRequest.description:
Create-service validation (Plan §39). Money is integer minor units (≥0);
currency is an allowlisted uppercase ISO code (KES default); duration is whole
minutes (>0). `category_id`/`branch_id` are branch ULIDs resolved + ownership-
checked in the controller.
StoreServiceRequest.title: StoreServiceRequest

TransferAppointmentRequest.description:
Transfer-appointment validation (Plan §36). The target personnel is a public
staff ULID (must differ from the current assignee — enforced in the action) and
an optional reason is sanitised before it reaches the audit record. Front Office
only; Branch Manager is rejected by the policy.
TransferAppointmentRequest.title: TransferAppointmentRequest

UpdateAvailabilityRequest.description:
Atomic availability-replacement payload (Plan §80 Phase 15B). HR authority is
route-gated (`personnel.availability.manage`) + policy-checked. The body carries
the COMPLETE new recurring + exception schedule and a required human-readable
change reason. merchant_id / branch_id are NEVER accepted from the body — they
are derived from the staff profile in the domain action. Structural + overlap
validation is delegated to the shared ScheduleNormalizer so the API and the
action share one rule set.
UpdateAvailabilityRequest.title: UpdateAvailabilityRequest

UpdateBranchRequest.description:
Validate a branch profile update (Scope §3.3). Code stays unique per merchant,
ignoring the current branch.
UpdateBranchRequest.title: UpdateBranchRequest

UpdateClientRequest.description:
Update-client validation (Plan §35). All fields optional; a changed phone is
re-normalized/re-indexed and re-checked for same-branch duplicates in the action.
UpdateClientRequest.title: UpdateClientRequest

UpdateOperatingHoursRequest.description:
Validate a weekly operating-hours upsert (Scope §3.3 Branch Operating
Calendar). Expects one entry per weekday (0–6).
UpdateOperatingHoursRequest.title: UpdateOperatingHoursRequest

UpdateServiceRequest.description:
Update-service validation (Plan §39). All fields optional; the same money/
currency/duration invariants apply. The legacy preferred-personnel fee is not
accepted here (non-editable seam).
UpdateServiceRequest.title: UpdateServiceRequest

VerifyMagicLinkRequest.description:
Validates a Magic Link verify submission (Plan §9.1). Public endpoint.

Only shape is validated here; whether the token is genuine/unexpired/unused is
decided by the atomic consume, never by validation (so timing and messages
stay uniform — no enumeration).
VerifyMagicLinkRequest.title: VerifyMagicLinkRequest
